title: Father's Hospitalization and Recovery
content: Father was admitted to the hospital on 2 October due to a heart condition. He was initially taken to the emergency room, then to the ICU in the town where he was later shifted to Napur. An angiography revealed a t-person blockage in his right artery, which was fixed through angioplasty. Now he is recovering. The speaker and their brother flew from Hyderabad to Napur to be with him. The speaker will now stay at home with their father for a few weeks after bringing him back home.
raw_text: So, my father was admitted to the hospital now, he got some heart condition, 2 days ago that means on 2 October he was taken to the emergency room, then to ICU in my town, then he was shifted to Napur, there his angiography was done where it was found that in his right artery there was a t-person blockage which was fixed by angioplasty and now he's okay now I am going to bring him back home. I was in Hyderabad but we my brother and I flew to Napur then now I will not be going to Hyderabad I will be staying at home with my father for a few weeks I guess.
